_comment: Operator inputs for goal 12 (agentic evals). Read by the agentic-serving skill; see its references/ci-compute.md for the compute contract.

compute._max_parallel_note: Six machines are available on this runner label. This is a ceiling you may fill when the plan needs it, not a quota to spend.
compute._run_timeout_note: CI enforces this; the stage does not. It is a planning bound: do not dispatch work whose estimate tops it, since such a run is killed and returns nothing. The local 4x Blackhole device stays available for quick checks.
compute._dispatch_note: Inputs are passed through to the workflow_dispatch block of manual-tt-shield-dispatch.yml. 'workflow' there selects the suite kind (release|benchmarks|evals|agentic|spec_tests); set run-full-evals true only for a scored full suite, since it disables --ci-mode.

publish._note: The dispatch takes refs, not repositories, so it clones the canonical upstreams. A fork is not reachable; push the branch to the upstream repo and dispatch the resulting SHA.

_batch_sizes_note: Stage 10 validates a tuned config per batch; stage 11 measures all; evals run once on the largest the device holds (16 instead of 32 is fine if recorded).
